text: Outstanding croissants and sourdough ... We had the normal croissant that had a perfect crust and buttery layers, an almond croissant that was generously filled with almonds and not overtly sweet, and we had a seeded sourdough which one we delicious just with butter. We will be back to try the other sourdough offerings here!!!
author: Eugene Hor

text: Quality bread and pastries in a quiet neighbourhood. I like the croissant and apple danish the most. No seat inside, only takeaway, there’s a bench outside.
author: Tianshu Tan

text: One of the best sourdough focaccias I’ve had! Very delish and the base is soo soft and airy! The milk loaf and pear danish are very good too!
author: Andy Y

text: I had a delicious croissant. Wonderful service. Great experience.
author: Charli Jeremy
